rv.q: Brilliantly adapted from the novel by Herman Melville, “Moby Dick in the Dark” is a treat for fans of old-time radio.

However, even with all the excess whale fat trimmed away, Moby Dick in the Dark still struggled to hold my attention over its short runtime – and despite the care woven into its storytelling, I simply didn’t connect with it.

cn.t: This audio-only Zoom adaptation of Melville's classic divides critics: some praise the 90-minute abridgement and iambic pentameter as a radio-style marvel, while others find the execution less compelling.
